```{r}
# --- Load required packages ----
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# --- 0. Load collar data from file if not already in memory ----
library(readr)
library(readxl)

if (!exists("clean_collar_dat")) {
  message("🔍 Loading collar data from 'collars_clean_master.csv'...")
  collar_path <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "collars_clean_master.csv")

  if (file.exists(collar_path)) {
    clean_collar_dat <- read_csv(collar_path)
    message("✅ Loaded: collars_clean_master.csv")
  } else {
    stop("❌ Could not find 'collars_clean_master.csv' in your WORK_DIR.")
  }
}

# --- 1. Clean collar data (remove missing coordinates) ----
clean_collar_dat <- clean_collar_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude))

# --- 2. Convert collars to sf ----
collars_sf <- st_as_sf(
  clean_collar_dat,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)
message("✅ collars_sf created successfully")

# --- 3. Load and combine all geopackage plots ----
plot_dir <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "Plot geopacks")
plot_files <- list.files(plot_dir, pattern = "\\.gpkg$", full.names = TRUE)

plots <- map_dfr(plot_files, function(f) {
  p <- st_read(f, quiet = TRUE)
  p$Source_File <- basename(f)
  p
})

# --- 4. Extract treatment from filename ----
plots <- plots %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment_Code = str_sub(Source_File, -6, -6),
    Treatment = case_when(
      Treatment_Code == "C" ~ "Continuous",
      Treatment_Code == "D" ~ "Deferred",
      Treatment_Code == "E" ~ "Exclosed",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# --- 5. Diagnostic: check coordinate ranges ----
message("🔍 Checking coordinate ranges...")
print("Collars bounding box:")
print(st_bbox(collars_sf))
print("Plots bounding box:")
print(st_bbox(plots))

# --- 6. Auto-fix mislabeled UTM plots ----
if (st_bbox(plots)$xmin > 1000) {
  message("⚠️  Plot coordinates appear to be in UTM metres — correcting CRS to EPSG:26911.")
  plots <- st_set_crs(plots, 26911)   # NAD83 / UTM Zone 11N
  plots <- st_transform(plots, 4326)  # convert to lat/long (WGS84)
}

# --- 7. Visual sanity check (optional) ----
plot(st_geometry(plots), border = "grey")
plot(st_geometry(collars_sf), col = "red", pch = 20, add = TRUE)

# --- 8. Align CRS (in case anything still differs) ----
if (st_crs(plots) != st_crs(collars_sf)) {
  plots <- st_transform(plots, st_crs(collars_sf))
}

# --- 9. Spatial join ----
collars_joined <- st_join(collars_sf, plots, join = st_within)
message(paste("✅ Spatial join complete. Rows matched:", nrow(collars_joined)))

# --- 10. Calculate time between consecutive fixes ----
collars_joined <- collars_joined %>%
  arrange(Cow_id, Time.Mountain) %>%
  mutate(Time.Mountain = ymd_hms(Time.Mountain)) %>%
  group_by(Cow_id) %>%
  mutate(TimeSpent_min = as.numeric(difftime(lead(Time.Mountain), Time.Mountain, units = "mins"))) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 11. Keep only rows where cow stayed in same plot ----
collars_joined <- collars_joined %>%
  mutate(SamePlot = Plot.ID == lead(Plot.ID)) %>%
  filter(SamePlot)

# --- 12. Define grazing phases ----
collars_joined <- collars_joined %>%
  mutate(
    Phase_Period = case_when(
      Time.Mountain >= ymd("2024-07-01") & Time.Mountain <= ymd("2024-08-03") ~ "Phase 1: July 1–Aug 3",
      Time.Mountain >= ymd("2024-08-04") & Time.Mountain <= ymd("2024-09-03") ~ "Phase 2: Aug 4–Sept 3",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Phase_Period))

# --- 13. Summarize total time per animal × plot × phase ----
time_per_animal_plot_phase <- collars_joined %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Phase_Period, Cow_id, Plot.ID, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(TotalTime_min = sum(TimeSpent_min, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 14. Average time per plot (across animals) per phase ----
avg_time_per_plot_phase <- time_per_animal_plot_phase %>%
  group_by(Phase_Period, Plot.ID, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanTime_min = mean(TotalTime_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDTime_min   = sd(TotalTime_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cows       = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 15. Average time per treatment per phase ----
avg_time_per_treatment_phase <- avg_time_per_plot_phase %>%
  group_by(Phase_Period, Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanPlotTime_min = mean(MeanTime_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    SDPlotTime_min   = sd(MeanTime_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_plots          = n()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 16. Plot average time per plot (faceted by phase) ----
ggplot(avg_time_per_plot_phase, aes(x = Plot.ID, y = MeanTime_min, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanTime_min - SDTime_min, ymax = MeanTime_min + SDTime_min), width = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~Phase_Period, ncol = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Time Spent by Cattle per Plot (by Phase)",
    x = "Plot ID",
    y = "Mean Time per Plot (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# --- 17. Plot average time per treatment per phase ----
ggplot(avg_time_per_treatment_phase, aes(x = Treatment, y = MeanPlotTime_min, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanPlotTime_min - SDPlotTime_min, ymax = MeanPlotTime_min + SDPlotTime_min),
                width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Phase_Period) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Time Spent per Treatment (by Phase)",
    x = "Treatment",
    y = "Mean Time (minutes)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
